user.title: Greek electricity prices
user.description: Day-ahead prices for Greece from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform. Request a free API token at transparency.entsoe.eu (My Account Settings → Web API Security Token).

data_description.supplier_margin: Your supplier's margin on top of the wholesale price (€/kWh), as stated in your contract.
data_description.other_charges: Regulated per-kWh charges (network, ΥΚΩ, ΕΤΜΕΑΡ, ΕΦΚ, ...) from your bill.
data_description.vat: VAT percentage (6% for electricity in Greece).
data_description.cheap_hours: How many hours count as cheap, and the length of the cheapest contiguous window.
